Players Committee card image of [[Despair (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.
